# Samuel Keter — Cloud Security & DevSecOps Leader

> Samuel Keter is a cloud security and DevSecOps leader based in Nairobi, Kenya, with more than 10 years of experience securing fintech and tier-1 banking systems. He most recently served as Staff Engineering Manager, Cloud Security & Compliance at Yassir (2024–2026), and previously led cyber defense across 6 markets with a team of 20 at Equity Bank Group, after roles at KPMG East Africa and PwC Kenya. He holds CCISO (2019) and CEH (2016) certifications and a BSc in Computer Science from Kabarak University.

## Expertise
- Cloud security architecture across GCP, Azure and AWS
- DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline security, IaC scanning, Kubernetes security
- Fintech and tier-1 banking security: ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, SWIFT CSP, Zero Trust
- IAM hardening, threat modeling, incident command, GRC and audit readiness
- Security team leadership: strategy, board-level reporting, teams up to 20

## Career highlights
- Owned enterprise-wide cloud security at Yassir: ISO 27001 ISMS, SOC 2 readiness, posture checks across 8 cloud environment groups
- Cut critical cloud vulnerabilities from 48 to 5 and open audit findings from 22 to 3
- Contained a high-severity incident in 4 hours; runbook adopted group-wide
- Led cyber defense across 6 African markets with a team of 20 at Equity Bank; containment cut from weeks to hours
- 20+ security maturity assessments and penetration tests across 4 markets at KPMG East Africa
- Security awareness training delivered to 5,000+ employees
